# XYZ reference fixtures

These compact fixtures were hand-reduced on 2026-09-01 to exercise the
grammar documented by the official libAtoms extXYZ specification:
https://github.com/libAtoms/extxyz

They are parser and geometry references, not claimed outputs of a physical
calculation.
